text: In April 2024 nexeye announced that investment funds and accounts managed by KKR agreed to acquire the company from investment firm 3i Group plc; KKR invests primarily through its European Fund VI.

source.name: nexeye newsroom: European Value-for-Money Optical Platform nexeye to be Acquired by KKR from 3i
source.quote: a definitive agreement has been signed whereby investment funds and accounts managed by KKR agreed to acquire the Company from investment firm 3i Group plc
